ocr_step.title: Read the document (OCR)
ocr_step.text: Ocr (read the document): outputs the text of the startup files of the run (or of the files produced by the linked sources, which win). ocrModelKey picks the OCR model (otherwise the one of the agent in agentId): it must be global or assigned to the application (list_application_ocr_models), an existing model that is not fails the save (ocr_models.not_assigned) and an unknown key is a bad request. With ocrModelKey omitted (and no OCR on the agent) the step is 'Let Evolus decide': it reads the documents with the platform OCR model (role ocr.default), charged in credits like a chosen one; when the subscription plan does not include AI_OCR (or the role has no model) the step reads only the text already in the file, for free. stepConfigJson.nativeTextOnly true = 'Only the text of the document': the step reads only the text already present in the file (PDF with text, .docx, Excel, plain text), no OCR and no cost, scanned pages stay empty; it cannot be saved together with ocrModelKey (422 on nativeTextOnly) and with it preferNativeText has no effect.

agent_step.title: Ask an agent
agent_step.text: AgentCall (call an agent): agentId is REQUIRED (validation error on agentId). The agent receives the step input, preceded by prompt when set (prompt accepts {{param:name}}), and its answer is the step output; without an output structure a failing call is tried up to 3 times. With outputStructureId the answer is structured by that output structure (see create_output_structure: output check, corrections and outputCheckNote), and with createDoc true (default) a CSV or text result also becomes a FILE (result_<timestamp>.csv/.txt, or named after the first startup file with createDocKeepFileName) for the linked Email/Webhook steps. An agent with file tools can deliver a file as the step output, byte for byte.
